summary: Verified the 9-catalog-category rollout across employer leads screen, post-a-job form, backend POST /api/employer/jobs and the freelancer jobs feed. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_post_job_categories.py — all 9 catalog categories accepted with correct legacy-bucket mapping (Graphics & Design/Writing & Translation/Video & Animation/Music & Audio→Creative, Programming & Tech/AI Services→Tech, Digital Marketing→Marketing, Business/Consulting→Ops), legacy Creative/Tech/Marketing/Ops still work, 'Bogus' returns 400, no-credit employer returns 402, and end-to-end a posted 'Digital Marketing' job (category='Digital Marketing', bucket='Marketing') appears in GET /api/jobs and in ?bucket=Marketing. Frontend @ 390x844: /employer renders lead-category-chip-row with all 10 chips (ALL + 9 catalog), BUSINESS→12 leads (CFO/CA/Scrum…), GRAPHICS & DESIGN→11 leads, ALL→50, search+chip combined ('ca' + BUSINESS → 3 rows). /employer/post-job shows all 9 catalog chips wrapped (postjob-cat-*); Graphics & Design is default active (bg #121212), tapping DIGITAL MARKETING moves the active highlight correctly. Freelancer regression on /freelancer/jobs still passes: ALL=201, GRAPHICS & DESIGN=45, DIGITAL MARKETING=32, ALL restores 201. TEST_ artifacts cleaned from db.plan_purchases and db.custom_jobs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' still emitted on /employer and /freelancer/jobs. Non-blocking, third-party lib origin — pre-existing, tracked in iteration_12.
Console error 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' still emitted on /freelancer/jobs and /employer. Non-blocking, pre-existing, tracked in iteration_12.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/employer/jobs stores job.category = req.bucket (catalog name for new posts, legacy string for legacy posts). Because the field is overloaded (sometimes a catalog category, sometimes a legacy bucket like 'Creative'), the freelancer feed's JOB_CATEGORY_FILTERS must list both the catalog name and its legacy alias inside every bucket — that hand-maintained dual mapping is fragile. Consider persisting a canonical catalog_category separately from the legacy bucket to remove the ambiguity.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture inserted 20 single-post credits under a per-run TEST_emp_* employer_id into db.plan_purchases (test_database) and created ~15 TEST_-titled custom_jobs during the parametrized runs. Fixture teardown removes both; a follow-up sweep confirmed 0 remaining TEST_ purchases/jobs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For any future POST /api/employer/jobs testing: give the employer a credit by inserting {employer_id, plan_id:'single-post'} into db.plan_purchases (test_database). Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. TestIDs in play: lead-category-chip-row + lead-chip-{all|graphics-design|programming-tech|digital-marketing|writing-translation|video-animation|ai-services|music-audio|business|consulting}; postjob-cat-<slug> using the same slug scheme; cat-chip-<slug> on the freelancer jobs feed.
